He called his nominee a 'wonderful man' who 'the Democrats are working hard to destroy' and potentially 'one of our greatest Supreme Court Justices ever' This comes after Trump told reporters in New York earlier in the day that he hoped Kavanaugh will be confirmed quickly His defense comes as Kavanaugh blasts a 'smear' campaign against him and vows he won't let it drive him out of the confirmation process.
largest_gains.article_only: President Trump tweeted his support for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh on Monday night. Trump slammed the charges against Kavanaugh as 'totally political' and slammed the accusers for waiting so long to speak out. He also suggested looking into the legal teams behind the charges. The tweet was the third time in a day Trump publicly defended his nominee. Earlier Monday, the President personally rang up Kavanaugh, assuring him that he would continue to support him.
